verdict.rationale: CloudConvert documents a first-party AI feature where you 'describe what should happen with your files, and an AI model takes care of it.' It also documents use of its file tools from ChatGPT, Claude and other MCP clients, so users can drive conversions in natural language. Both claims are single-line doc mentions with no detail. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the AI feature's scope and limits, supported natural-language operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
